items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Interviewer asks about 'Miss Cole's lawn parties', Interviewee responds by describing playing at a location ('Fing and Willows') but does not mention Miss Cole personally or describe a direct interaction with her.

ctx.x: That's where the National Park was. The National Park.
Yeah, I mean we played there every Monday night, Sunday night. But what about Miss Cole's lawn parties?
I was just at Fing and Willows. Yeah, I played there a couple of times too. A little yard, you know? Yeah. I mean we played there every Monday night, Sunday night.
